initial_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the file has crash deaths but no vehicle-miles-traveled exposure, so it cannot calculate motorist deaths per mile or directly establish per-mile risk change
initial_plan.metric: share of police-reported NYC crash records with at least one motorist killed, by year
initial_plan.denominator: all police-reported NYC crash records in each calendar year with a usable crash_date; this is not miles driven or motorist trips
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated 2013 through 2025
initial_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; assess coverage of boundary years from crash_date

facts.date_coverage: Each year 2013-2025 has dated rows spanning January 1 through December 31; the DATE type prevents impossible date values, though endpoint coverage alone cannot prove every date is represented.

data_check.meaning_and_decisions: The year filter excludes records outside 2013-2025; none of 2,269,187 source records has a missing crash_date, and every target year has rows at both calendar endpoints. In-scope annual crash-row counts range from 85,546 to 231,564. The motorist-death field used to classify crash records is missing on 0 rows in every target year, so no in-scope record is dropped from either the numerator or denominator for missingness; use all in-scope crash records as the denominator. Treat endpoint observations as evidence of calendar-span coverage, not proof of row-level completeness. No part of this check provides vehicle-miles-traveled exposure.

final_plan.can_answer_question: partly: this file cannot measure per-mile risk or establish whether it declined because vehicle-miles-traveled exposure is absent; it can show the share of reported crashes involving a reported motorist death
final_plan.metric: annual share of crash records with number_of_motorist_killed greater than zero
final_plan.denominator: all police-reported NYC crash records with a nonmissing crash_date in that calendar year; the value is a share of crash records, not of miles or trips
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with a nonmissing crash_date in 2013-2025
final_plan.missingness_decision: Keep all eligible crash records in the denominator; classify a record as involving a motorist death when number_of_motorist_killed is greater than zero. That field has no missing values in any target year. Records with missing crash_date would be excluded from year assignment, but none are present in the source rows checked.
final_plan.limitations: This is the share of reported crash records with one or more motorists killed, not risk per mile or the chance a motorist dies during driving; vehicle-miles traveled and individual driving exposure are unavailable. It conditions on a crash being reported and can change with the number and types of crashes. Target years have records spanning January 1-December 31, but endpoint dates do not verify complete reporting across all days.
